scope: Prerequisite map and missing local supplier designs for the direct numerical-linear-algebra dossier.

supplier_layers.role: Adjoints, orthogonal projections, spectral theorems, positive square roots, and exact SVD.
Condition numbers, normwise/componentwise perturbation sizes, standard relative model, gamma_n accumulation, dot products and forward/backward error relationships.
Exact solve/factorization contracts, LU/PLU and Cholesky hypotheses, QR construction/cost, and the currently conditional backward-error theorem.
Exact least-squares minimizers, minimum norm, projections, regularization, and the condition-number-square caveat.
Exact-arithmetic eigenpair and iteration results with explicit spectral-gap, simplicity, and initialization assumptions.

missing_supplier_designs.existing_carrier_status: published conditional theorem; its explicit [A1] local-step bound is a hypothesis, not discharged by the item
missing_supplier_designs.needed_claim: For one active trailing block and the explicit stable-sign Householder construction, under a stated standard relative model with no range exceptions, produce an exact orthogonal reflector H_k and perturbation E_k such that H_k(B_k+E_k)=B_{k+1}, with a fully derived explicit bound. Match or replace the current 3 gamma_m constant.
proof_route: analyze stable norm/scaling, reflector-vector formation, and dot products under the standard model
bound the rank-one trailing-block update entrywise and collect local perturbations
construct the exact orthogonal reflector associated with represented data; handle the zero-vector/no-op case
if exact orthogonality is not maintained, revise the global aggregation theorem to account for reflector norm growth

missing_supplier_designs.gap: The active direct page defines the Cholesky factorization and proves exact existence, uniqueness, solve, and dense cost, but does not specify the computational recurrence as an algorithm item.
missing_supplier_designs.contract: Input Hermitian positive-definite A. For j=0,...,n-1, compute d_j=a_jj-sum_{k<j}|l_jk|^2, set l_jj=sqrt(d_j)>0, then for i>j set l_ij=(a_ij-sum_{k<j}l_ik conjugate(l_jk))/l_jj. Return lower-triangular L.
proof_route: state inputs, output, exact recurrence, and pivot/radicand admissibility
derive the Schur-complement interpretation from the existing SPD theorem
separate exact correctness/termination and arithmetic-cost theorems from the floating-point property

missing_supplier_designs.gap: No Cholesky backward-error theorem is present among the direct published suppliers.
missing_supplier_designs.contract: For a successful computed Cholesky recurrence in the standard relative model, with all operations in range and positive computed pivots, prove A+E=Lhat Lhat* with E Hermitian and an explicit entrywise/normwise bound derived from the recurrence. The familiar componentwise target is O(gamma_n)|Lhat||Lhat*|; derive the exact gamma constant before stating it.
proof_route: bound each diagonal/off-diagonal inner product with the dot-product theorem
include square-root and division rounding explicitly
assemble symmetric residuals and bound them componentwise
convert to normwise backward error, then use existing condition/backward-error estimates for forward consequences

missing_supplier_designs.scope_condition: Include only if the new Numerical Analysis scope promises stability of the computed least-squares solution beyond exact QR factorization stability.
missing_supplier_designs.gap: The published reduced-QR item proves the exact minimizer and unsquared condition number. The Householder QR item proves only a factorization backward bound under [A1]; no computed-solution LS backward-error contract is present.
missing_supplier_designs.contract: For full-column-rank A and a specified computed Householder-QR plus triangular-solve procedure, give explicit hypotheses under which xhat is an exact least-squares minimizer for nearby A+DeltaA,b+Deltab with a derived normwise/componentwise bound.
proof_route: discharge the local Householder step lemma
bound computed Q* b projection with the floating-point dot-product theorem
bound back substitution as the exact solution to a nearby triangular system
compose perturbations into a declared least-squares backward-error definition
convert to forward error using a stated least-squares condition measure

missing_supplier_designs.scope_condition: Needed only if the scaffold promises a numerical SVD computation; the published exact SVD theorem, singular-value identities, pseudoinverse, and truncated-SVD contracts are already complete.
missing_supplier_designs.gap: The active SVD page proves exact existence and consequences but contains no numerical SVD procedure or finite-precision stability theorem. FNC §7.3 also defers the exact SVD proof and supplies no computational method.
missing_supplier_designs.contract: If selected, specify a concrete method such as two-sided Householder reduction to bidiagonal form followed by implicit shifted QR/deflation on the bidiagonal matrix; state dimensions, transformations, deflation/stopping conditions, output factors, and error model. Prove a nearby-matrix factorization bound for the computed result.
proof_route: prove exact bidiagonal reduction by successive left/right Householder transformations
prove exact bidiagonal QR steps preserve singular values and converge under stated deflation conditions
bound rounding in reductions and QR steps by local unitary-step perturbations
compose local perturbations using unitary invariance
keep tolerance-based numerical rank separate from exact rank
missing_supplier_designs.source_requirement: No full-text numerical-SVD algorithm source was read in this dossier; obtain and read one before authoring this branch.

missing_supplier_designs.scope_condition: Optional; include only if the plan promises a concrete operation-count comparison.
missing_supplier_designs.gap: FNC §3.2, Theorem 3.2.3 gives the count, while active local items prove condition-number squaring and Cholesky costs but do not package the complete normal-equation count.
missing_supplier_designs.contract: Under a declared flop convention, count symmetry-aware formation of A^T A, formation of A^T b, Cholesky solution, and triangular substitutions separately; derive the leading mn^2+n^3/3 count and label lower-order terms.
proof_route: define one flop explicitly
count only one triangle of A^T A and mirror it
count A^T b
add existing Cholesky and triangular-solve costs
keep wall-clock performance outside the theorem

open_problem_classification.instruction: Every listed gap is a known numerical-analysis result/procedure lacking a local contract or proof supplier. Encode as algorithm/definition/theorem/lemma with complete local proofs if selected; never use op- merely because a proof is not yet authored.

cross_scope_note: Finite-precision stability of QR eigensolvers and Krylov solvers may be owned by the iterative-methods dossier. Current eigenvalue-iteration claims are exact-arithmetic convergence theorems with explicit hypotheses, plus an exact residual/backward-error identity.
